spans.s: मठ् (I) vt. or vi. 1P (pres. मठति) 1. To dwell, to live; 2. to grind; 3. to go.
मठ् (II) vi. 1Ā (pres. मंठते) 1. To meditate sorrowfully, to remember with regret; 2. to long for.
मठ m.n. 1. A hut, a small building inhabited by an ascetic or devotee; 2. a monastery, a college; 3. a temple; 4. a carriage drawn by oxen.
मठ-आयतन n. a college, a monastery.
माठर m. 1. an epithet of Vyāsa; 2. a Brāhmaṇa; 3. a distiller; 4. an attendant on the sun.
मठी f. 1. A cell; 2. a cloister.
